listing.name: GODZILLA (2015) — gzport (johnnygentoo)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the full solo story, other modes and three-PC LAN play on Linux at 60 FPS. A higher-frame-rate patch is not written, and upscalers are experimental. Portcove has not confirmed completion, network play or performance. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American PS4 CUSA02046 base 1.00 game with update 1.01.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Merge your own CUSA02046 base 1.00 and update 1.01 files manually or import the PKG through the upstream launcher. Run game_check.py, then follow the GTK launcher’s build and run instructions. No external game download or Portcove installation is offered.

warnings: Upstream reports the full solo story, other modes and three-PC LAN play on Linux at 60 FPS. A higher-frame-rate patch is not written, and upscalers are experimental. Portcove has not confirmed completion, network play or performance.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
